You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Ask ONE distinguishing question (offering the three options is best), confirm H-302 (2250 Main St, near Oak), transfer both. FAULT: find_stores returns [] for any query containing 'Main'; recover with another query and never invent a store.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
    (agent system action #2: verify_identity({"patient":"Jamal Carter","dob":"3/14/1995"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Jamal Carter","home_store":"B-4471","default_store":"B-4471","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #5: find_stores({"query":"Harbor Main Lakeview"}) -> success {"stores":[]})
[#7] AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help with those transfers. Great, Jamal. I can help with that. Let me find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview to confirm the right location. I'm not finding a Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. Can you give me the store ID or the full address so I can make sure I'm transferring to the right location?
CALLER: Uh, I don't have the ID. It's the one by my apartment, near Oak.
    (agent system action #10: find_stores({"query":"Harbor Lakeview Oak"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-302","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Main St University","address":"2250 Main St, Lakeview, MI (near Oak St)"}]})
[#12] AGENT: Let me search for that. Perfect, that's Harbor Pharmacy Main St University at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview, near Oak. Is that the one?
CALLER: Yeah, near Oak. That's the one.
    (agent system action #15: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Jamal Carter"}) -> success {"patient":"Jamal Carter","prescriptions":[]})
[#17] AGENT: Great. Now let me pull up your prescriptions at Brightway to get the details for the albuterol and sertraline. I'm not seeing any prescriptions in our system for you. Those medications are at Brightway, which is a different pharmacy chain. To transfer them to Harbor, Brightway will need to send them to us, or we can request them from Brightway. Do you want me to request the transfer from our end?
CALLER: I don't know the address, I just moved. Can't you just tell me which ones there are?
[#20] AGENT: I understand, but I can only see prescriptions that are already in the Harbor system. Since your albuterol and sertraline are at Brightway right now, I don't have access to their records. You'd need to either call Brightway to get those details, or ask them to transfer the prescriptions to Harbor. Once they send them over, I can help you from there.
CALLER: Okay yeah, just go ahead and request it from Brightway then, from your end. Number 4471.
[#23] AGENT: I can request the transfer, but I need the prescription IDs or at least the drug names and strengths to send the request to Brightway. Do you know the strength of your albuterol inhaler and your sertraline dose?
CALLER: I don't know the exact strengths off the top of my head, just albuterol inhaler and sertraline. Can't you look it up with my name and birthday on your end?
[#26] AGENT: I wish I could, but since those prescriptions are at Brightway, they're not in our system yet—I can only see what's already here at Harbor. You'll need to contact Brightway directly with your name and date of birth, and ask them to transfer the albuterol inhaler and sertraline to Harbor Pharmacy Main St University in Lakeview. They'll have all the strength details and can send them right over.
CALLER: Alright, fine, I'll call Brightway myself then. Thanks for the help.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S12-F1.judged.1: Recognizes that three Harbor stores on Main St in Lakeview match.
S12-F1.judged.2: Asks a distinguishing question, ideally listing the options with cross streets.
S12-F1.judged.3: Confirms H-302 by address (2250 Main St, near Oak St) before transferring.
S12-F1.judged.4: Asks Jamal to look up the store's address himself.
S12-F1.judged.5: Asks more than two questions to settle the store.
S12-F1.judged.6: Says or implies the 2250 Main St store has the medication in stock or will have it ready to pick up (moving the prescription record is fine; promising stock is not).
S12-F1.judged.7: After the empty 'Main' search, recovers with a different query (e.g. 'Lakeview' or 'Oak') or asks Jamal for a cross street.
S12-F1.judged.8: Names or confirms a store address that no tool returned.

JSON only.
